title: VaultLeaseKeeperService
responsibility: Issues, attaches and ends Credential Vault CDP leases with one-time handoff tokens and plans teardown.

inputs.name: VaultLeaseKeeperService.constructor.broker
inputs.description: Broker that confirms the delivered request.

inputs.name: VaultLeaseKeeperService.constructor.audit
inputs.description: Journal for lease, attach and lease-end events.

inputs.name: VaultLeaseKeeperService.constructor.runDirectory
inputs.description: Directory holding each lease's cdp.sock.

inputs.name: VaultLeaseKeeperService.constructor.now
inputs.description: Clock in Unix milliseconds; defaults to Date.now.

inputs.name: VaultLeaseKeeperService.issue.ticket
inputs.description: Request id and receipt of the delivered request.

inputs.name: VaultLeaseKeeperService.issue.uid
inputs.description: Caller OS user; must match the creator.

inputs.name: VaultLeaseKeeperService.issue.teardown
inputs.description: Recipe logout, revoke and security-log paths, each nullable.

inputs.name: VaultLeaseKeeperService.attach.lease
inputs.description: Lease id.

inputs.name: VaultLeaseKeeperService.attach.session
inputs.description: Requesting session name.

inputs.name: VaultLeaseKeeperService.attach.uid
inputs.description: Caller OS user; must be the session user.

inputs.name: VaultLeaseKeeperService.admit.lease
inputs.description: Lease id the relay connection is for.

inputs.name: VaultLeaseKeeperService.admit.peerUid
inputs.description: Kernel-verified OS user of the connection, or null.

inputs.name: VaultLeaseKeeperService.admit.token
inputs.description: Bearer token the connection presented.

inputs.name: VaultLeaseKeeperService.finish.lease
inputs.description: Lease id.

inputs.name: VaultLeaseKeeperService.finish.session
inputs.description: Requesting session name.

inputs.name: VaultLeaseKeeperService.finish.uid
inputs.description: Caller OS user; must be the session user.

outputs.name: VaultLeaseKeeperService.issue
outputs.description: Lease id, claim deadline and hard expiry.

outputs.name: VaultLeaseKeeperService.attach
outputs.description: The lease's CDP endpoint, a one-time bearer header and the expiry; only the token digest is kept.

outputs.name: VaultLeaseKeeperService.admit
outputs.description: Allowed, or refused with a reason when the lease is not attached or the peer, token or lease state fails.

outputs.name: VaultLeaseKeeperService.finish
outputs.description: The ended lease with its teardown plan.

outputs.name: VaultLeaseKeeperService.sweep
outputs.description: Teardown plans of leases that ended on this tick, each planned once.

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 404 'Request not found.' when the request id is unknown, the caller's uid differs from the creator's, or the receipt does not match.

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 409 'The request was not delivered.'

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 409 'This request already has a lease.'

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 403 'A CDP lease needs the kernel-verified session user.' when the request has no uid.

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 500 'Refused a malformed audit record.' or a file-system error when the journal append fails.

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 404 'Lease not found.' when the lease id is unknown or the session or uid is not the requester's.

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 409 'The lease is already attached; reconnect with its token.'

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 409 with the lease's refusal reason when the claim is refused, for example after the claim window.

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: 409 with the lease's refusal reason, or 'The lease already ended.' when its plan was already returned.
